text: Best dictation service I've ever used. The built-in voice dictation in my regular keyboards like SwiftKey is not that great, and even the dictation features in chatbots like ChatGPT and Gemini are only good enough, I guess. This is the best: it really processes what you are trying to say, organises it in the best way, and rewrites it so the soul of what you want to say is not lost. I use it when I don't really want to type. It's the best out there, I guess, and I could pay for it someday.
